In addition, substantial verse segments are shared with various other poems in the *Vimānavatthu*, including *Guttilavimānavatthu* (Vv 33), *Maṇithūṇavimānavatthu* (Vv 77), *Dutiyabhikkhādāyikāvimānavatthu* (Vv 28), *Dvārapālavimānavatthu* (Vv 55), *Dutiyakuṇḍalīvimānavatthu* (Vv 73), and the preceding *Paṭhamanāgavimānavatthu* (Vv 60) [DharmaNexus].
